---
title: Extended Components
description: Every component added for docs.json component parity, in one page.
---

Each marker below is asserted by `tests/smoke.mjs`. The point is not that these look right —
that's a browser check — but that every one of them **resolves to a real component** instead
of silently degrading to its children, which is what an unregistered name does.

## Callouts

<Danger>DANGER_MARKER</Danger>

<Callout icon="rocket" color="#7C3AED">CUSTOM_CALLOUT_MARKER</Callout>

## Banner

`banner` in `docs.json` renders site-wide above the navbar (asserted on every fixture page,
not just this one). The same component is also available as a tag inside a page:

<Banner type="critical" dismissible>INLINE_BANNER_MARKER</Banner>

## Tree

<Tree>
  <Tree.Folder name="TREE_FOLDER_MARKER" defaultOpen>
    <Tree.File name="TREE_FILE_MARKER" />
    <Tree.File name="highlighted.ts" highlight />
  </Tree.Folder>
  <Tree.File name="TREE_ROOT_FILE_MARKER" />
</Tree>

The `FileTree` alias must resolve to the same component:

<FileTree>
  <Tree.File name="FILETREE_ALIAS_MARKER" />
</FileTree>

The Markdown list form is the *other* documented input, converted at the mdast stage. A
trailing slash marks a folder, nesting also marks one, and everything else is a file:

<FileTree>

- LIST_FOLDER_MARKER/
  - LIST_NESTED_FILE_MARKER
  - LIST_IMPLICIT_FOLDER_MARKER
    - LIST_DEEP_FILE_MARKER
- LIST_ROOT_FILE_MARKER

</FileTree>
